nodes.description: Knock-down of SMPD4 in human neural stem cells reduces proliferation and prolongs mitosis. In embryonic mouse cortex, Smpd4 knockdown increases cell-cycle exit and premature neuronal differentiation, exhausting apical progenitors. In gyrencephalic ferret cortex, Smpd4 knockout reduces progenitor proliferation, prolongs mitosis, depletes basal intermediate progenitors and disrupts neuronal migration. Progenitor depletion is the proposed basis of the congenital microcephaly and simplified gyral pattern.
